item.title: Data Science from Yesterday to Tomorrow, Part 2: Lessons from a Quarter-Century of Hype and Reality
item.description:
A 25-Year Chronological Retrospective (2000–Present), Physics-Informed Synthetic Realities, and Counterfactual Reasoning.

📖 Series Navigation: This is Part 2 of the Data Science from Yesterday to Tomorrow series. If you haven't read it yet, make sure to explore Part 1: Why Data Science + AI is Your Unstoppable Superpower ←, which covers the personal 15-year trek across the compute stack, the Parable of the Alpine Pass, clinical target leakage, and reactive computational graphs.
🖥️ Keynote Presentation: Explore the full companion presentation with dark-tech aesthetics, embedded telemetry animations, and keyboard navigation directly in your browser: Data Science: From Yesterday to Tomorrow (Interactive 24-Slide Deck) →
🏎️ Open Source Code & Telemetry Labs: The complete Python simulation engine, datasets, and Jupyter notebooks are hosted on GitHub: erolrecep/datascience_from_yesterday_to_tomorrow ↗

Executive Summary: The Quarter-Century Arc

Over the past twenty-five years, data science has repeatedly redefined its vocabulary. We have journeyed through Data Mining, Business Intelligence, the Big Data revolution, the Deep Learning renaissance, and now the epoch of Foundation Models and Agentic AI.
